data.name: Afiyat
data.gender_notes: Afiyat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Afiyat is an Arabic name derived from the word ‘Afiyah’ which means safety, security, protection, and well-being. This name is often used in the context of seeking Allah's protection and blessings. In Islamic history, it is also associated with the concept of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) being a source of peace and security for his followers.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of Allah's protection and care.
data.etymology: Afiyat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Safety, Security, Protection.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afiyat total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: عافية
in_arabic.meaning: سلامتی، تندرستی، خیریت، امن و سکون
in_arabic.long_meaning: عافية أصلها من العافية، وهي السلامة من كل شر، وتطلق على الصحة الجسدية والنفسية، وتعني أيضًا الخیریت والنماء، وقد وردت في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: «وإذا سألك عبادي عني فإني قريب أجيب دعوة الداع إذا دعاني» (البقرة: 186)، وهي من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني إيجابية وروحانية عالية

in_urdu.name: عافیہ
in_urdu.meaning: خیر، سلامتی، تندرستی، امن و سکون
in_urdu.long_meaning: عافیہ عربی زبان کے لفظ عافیت سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خیر، سلامتی، تندرستی، اور امن و سکون، یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں بہت اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ صفات اہل ایمان کی ہیں، جیسے کہ قرآن مجید میں ہے: «الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات طوبى لهم و حسن مآب» (الرعد: 29)

in_hindi.name: आफियत
in_hindi.long_meaning: आफियत नाम का अर्थ शांति, स्वास्थ्य, सुख और समृद्धि होता है, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है, और यह नाम अच्छे गुणों और आदर्शों को दर्शाता है, जैसे कि कुरआन में कहा गया है: «ويسألونك عن الروح قل روح من أمر ربي وما أوتيتم من العلم إلا قليلا» (الإسراء: 85)

in_pashto.name: عافية
in_pashto.long_meaning: عافية د عربي کلمه څخه اخیستل شوې ده، چې معنی یې سول، روغتیا، خوښی او ارام دی، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو لپاره ډیر اهمیت لري، ځکه چې دا د ښو صفاتو او ارزښتونو څرګندونه کوي، لکه څنګه چې قرآنکریم فرمايي: «اللہ يعلم ما في السموات والأرض، ويعلم ما تبدون وما تعفون» (المجادلة: 7)

historical_references.reference: Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa'l-Nihayah: The Destruction of the Umayyad Caliphate and the Rise of the Abbasids (132-145/750-763)
historical_references.context: Afiyah bint Muhammad, the sister of the last Umayyad caliph Marwan II, was known for her beauty and intelligence. She married the Abbasid caliph Al-Mansur and played a crucial role in the Abbasid takeover of the Umayyad caliphate by providing intelligence and support. After Marwan II was killed in battle, Afiyah was taken to Iraq and given the title 'Al-Khatun' (the lady), which became a title for the Abbasid caliphs' consorts. She was later granted the title 'Afiyah al-Mutawakkilah' (the one who comforts the caliph) after she comforted the caliph during a revolt.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Tabari's The History of al-Tabari: The Caliphate of Harun al-Rashid (170-193/786-809) The name Afiyat carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Afiyah bint al-Hasan al-Muzaffar was a Persian princess, the daughter of the ruler of Khurasan. She was known for her exceptional beauty and intelligence. Harun al-Rashid, the Abbasid caliph, was captivated by her and married her. Afiyah became a powerful figure in the caliph's court and was known for her wisdom and her ability to manage the caliph's vast empire. She was also a patron of scholars and poets and is remembered for her support of the arts.
